basis: No readable source assigns a use to this room. WR-CASTLE-001 carries the open blocker "castle floor plans not complete".

proposals.label: Private tutorial chamber of the royal household
proposals.why: WR-CASTLE-001 is lane CASTLE_ROYAL, titled "Family Castle + Royal House Completion", and the directive asks for learning/tutor rooms while forbidding modern school architecture. An upper, well-lit, single-window room off the family range is the household form of that use.
proposals.implies: Daylight-led lighting, a writing surface, storage for the period's own recordkeeping materials, a child-safe route from the family rooms, and no classroom fittings.

proposals.label: Record and archive chamber
proposals.why: The directive asks for an archive/record room. Records are kept high and dry, behind one controlled door, with a small opening.
proposals.implies: A small window rather than a large one, a lockable door, a guard or staff route rather than a public one, and restricted lighting because open flame near records is a hazard in every candidate period.

proposals.label: Private withdrawing room / bedchamber of the royal family
proposals.why: Upper-storey corner rooms with an outward window are the private end of the royal range in most of the candidate traditions.
proposals.implies: A royal route and a child-safe route, no service traffic through the room, a private rather than a receiving door, and furnishing recorded as household goods of the resolved period.

rule: Proposals are stored separately from the room's purpose, so a proposal can never be mistaken for an assignment.
